senses.gloss: , constr. כְּוַת, כְּוַות (v. יַת) [likeness,] like, in agreement with.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 44:18">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIV, 18</cite>.
Targ. Y. II, Num. XII, 7; a. e.—With pron. suffix: כְּוָתִי, כְּוָתָךְ, כְּוָתִיךְ, כְּוָתֵיה &c. like me &c.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 113:5">Targ. Ps. CXIII, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 15:11">Targ. Y. Ex. XV, 11</cite>; a. v. fr.—With prefix <he>דִּ</he>, v. <cite ref="D00769"><he>דִּכְוָת־</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 36a:6">Ber. 36ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הלכתא כותיה ד־</he> the practice is in agreement with the opinion of—(v. <cite ref="E00566"><he>הֲלָכָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 36a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>כותך מסתברא</he> reason agrees with thee.
<cite ref="Berakhot 36b:18">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>כותיה דרב כהנא וכ׳</he> reason is in favor of R. Kahana’s opinion.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 65a:7">B. Bath. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>הילכתא כְּוָותִין או … כְּוָתַיְיכוּ</he> must the rule be adopted agreeably to our opinion or to yours? (Ms. M. <he>כְּוָתֵיךְ … כְּוָתִין</he>); <cite ref="Bava Batra 142b:10">ib. 142ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:32">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵃ</cite> top <he>עבד עובדא כוותיה</he> acted in accordance with his own opinion; a. fr.
